description: Land Title Settlement Department - Divulankadawala, Kusumpokuna, Medirigiriya D/S Division, Polonnaruwa District - Cad. Map No. 120040 (24/0729)
categorisation: This gazette content deals exclusively with land title registration and determinations under the Registration of Title Act. It contains detailed schedules of specific land parcels with their ownership details, extents, and legal status. The content falls under "Land registrations, property ownership, land titles" as specified in the Land Gazettes (Type 4) category, and appears in "PART III - LANDS" of the gazette.
